"""Advisory task-kind recipes; never scheduling, routing or permission authority."""
RECIPES = {
    'generic': {
        'evidence': ['behavioral_acceptance', 'affected_dependencies'],
        'questions': ['State the user-visible result and non-goals.',
                      'Inspect callers, consumers and support files before freezing paths.']},
    'bug': {
        'evidence': ['observed_vs_expected', 'reproduction', 'root_cause', 'before_after_regression'],
        'questions': ['Record the observed and expected behavior with a concrete input.',
                      'Reproduce safely before editing and trace the first wrong boundary.',
                      'Plan a regression that distinguishes the broken and corrected behavior; cite any reproduction limit.']},
    'feature': {
        'evidence': ['user_journey', 'integration', 'negative_paths'],
        'questions': ['Describe the user journey and observable acceptance outcome.',
                      'Identify existing interfaces, integration dependencies and necessary support files.',
                      'Include invalid/empty states and actual outcome assertions, not screenshots alone.']},
    'maintenance': {
        'evidence': ['compatibility', 'before_after_behavior', 'migration_or_rollback'],
        'questions': ['State what behavior must remain compatible.',
                      'Separate behavior-preserving edits from intentional changes.',
                      'Name migration/rollback evidence when applicable; do not invent a migration.']},
}


def for_kind(kind='generic'):
    if kind not in RECIPES:
        raise ValueError('Unknown planning task kind: ' + str(kind))
    recipe = RECIPES[kind]
    return {'kind': kind, 'evidence': list(recipe['evidence']), 'questions': list(recipe['questions']),
            'changes_permissions': False,
            'authority': 'Advisory support only. Original requirements, owner scope, required checks and independent review remain mandatory.'}
